description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the LocationAPI class in the OrangeHRM Admin API module, specifically testing CRUD operations and validation rules for location management.

classes.name: LocationAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing CRUD operations and validation rules of the LocationAPI in the OrangeHRM Admin API plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the LocationAPI instance and populates test fixtures before each test.

methods.name: getTestCasesByKey
methods.description: Loads specific test cases from the fixture YAML files based on a key.

methods.name: testGettersAndSetters
methods.description: Tests the getter and setter methods of the LocationAPI instance.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single location by ID, asserting correct response or exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests validation rule for getting a single location.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all locations with given parameters.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Tests validation rule for getting all locations.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creation of a new location.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Tests validation rule for creating a location.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Tests validation rule for updating a location.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a location and verifies location count before and after.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests validation rule for deleting a location.
